request.style: English, male baritone solo with gentle choir, piano, strings, harp, warm and reassuring mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Day and night your hand was heavy
My vigor turned to summer dryness
I made my sin known to you
I did not cover up my guilt

[Chorus]
You are my hiding place
You guard me from all trouble
Surround me with songs
Songs of deliverance

[Verse]
I will instruct you and teach
The way you should go is clear
I will counsel you and watch
Over you with tender care

[Chorus]
You are my hiding place
You guard me from all trouble
Surround me with songs
Songs of deliverance

[Bridge]
Do not be like a horse
Without understanding or sense
Bit and bridle only curb
Else it will not come near

[Verse]
Many sorrows mark the wicked
But trust in the Lord is love
Steadfast love surrounds the soul
Who leans upon his grace

[Chorus]
You are my hiding place
You guard me from all trouble
Surround me with songs
Songs of deliverance

[Outro]
Rejoice in the Lord be glad
Shout for joy in heart
